verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the Word-template interaction that clicking the named insert field must clear its placeholder for direct text entry.
First concrete failure: clicking the named field did not clear its placeholder.
The client broadens the direct-entry behavior to applicable control fields so activation removes existing placeholder text without manual selection and deletion.
Distinct activation path: clicking within written placeholder text still required manual removal, although typing from the three-dot area behaved differently.
Distinct template and field coverage: customer testing reproduced the clearing failure across named Proposal fields, Guidance reflections, and the Board Seminar agenda.
